body:
I'll start by understanding the repository structure, the SKILL.md rules, the existing chapter style, and the available sources.

Now let me get exact verbatim lines for the fences I plan to include.

Let me verify exact line numbers for a few chapters' citations before writing.

I have all the facts needed. Writing Chapter 07 now.

Now writing Chapter 08 — the modern flag matrix.

Now writing Chapter 09 — images, registries and pull.

Now writing Chapter 10 — reproducible builds.

Let me run a targeted integrity self-check on my four files (citation ranges and fence contract) before finishing.

Completed all four assigned chapters in `runtimes/podman_guide/`:

| File | Lines | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `07-container-lifecycle.md` | 125 | State model (`create`/`run`/`init`/statuses), transition commands, `wait` conditions and exit codes, exec/attach/cp/port/logs/inspect/diff, rename/update/checkpoint/restore/clone, prune/`exists`/`--cidfile`/`--replace` CI teardown |
| `08-modern-run-flags.md` | 172 | Full v6.2 flag matrix grouped by purpose: pull (4 values), platform, auth/TLS, security, resource limits, env/secrets/mount types, network/publish, restart/health/sdnotify, logging, userns/identity; defaults + deterministic recommendations |
| `09-images-registries-and-pull.md` | 145 | Image command surface, registries.conf mirrors/blocking/insecure/aliases, auth paths and TLS, `podman pull --policy` vs `run --pull` defaults, digest pinning, policy.json trust and `--signature-policy`, push signing, save/load/scp/commit, GC |
| `10-reproducible-builds.md` | 156 | Determinism levers, minimal digest-pinned multi-stage Containerfile, file/target/build-arg/secret inputs, layers/squash/cache, platform/manifest/format, timestamp vs source-date-epoch, syft/trivy SBOM presets and outputs, auth/TLS, CI build command |

Verification performed (mechanical self-check mirroring `verify.py`, not `verify.py` itself): first-line titles, ≥3 `##` sections with `## Pitfalls`/`## Sources` last, all 273 citation tokens in range against existing files, and all 11 fences language-tagged with either a single verbatim source token matching the cited lines or an explicit `derived` marker — **0 issues**. I did not run `verify.py`, builds, or tests, per assignment.
